body_evidence.label: Hand across the body at release

explanation.basis: Compared with this athlete's 23 other analysed throws (same method version).
evidence: Aim (launched about 2° left of your usual line).
The slide (it slid 11 in further than usual).
Release speed +0.29 m/s against usual (noise 0.15 m/s); on its own, in a drag-free flight, about 15 in more carry.
explanation.observed: Ended off the board, 20 in long and 11 in left of the hole. First contact 9 in past the usual spot.
explanation.possible_explanation: The difference arose after landing (the slide), not in the flight; no release measure accounts for a single throw's slide.
explanation.suggestion: Watch the landing in the side view (bag flat or on edge, spin) and compare with throws that stayed.

attribution.sentence: Off the board: 20 in long, 11 in left. About half of the long came from the slide (it slid 11 in further than usual).

slide.reason: The slide did not decelerate steadily up the deck (bounce or tumble). Fitted on the plain deck before the hole.
